title: Chapter 591 - 591 Luck; Chance Encounter!
content:
Chapter 591 - 591 Luck; Chance Encounter!

Chapter 591 - 591 Luck; Chance Encounter!

591 Luck; Chance Encounter!

Lin Fan did not just freeze the surface of the lake and the Abyssal Octopus.

It was as if all the viewers in Hua Nation’s live stream were frozen too.

So much so that…

For a long time, there were no bullet comments in the live broadcast room.

As the host, Xiao Bing said almost professionally, “So powerful.”

Her voice was not loud.

However, it caused the entire live broadcast room to boil.

World’s Best: [F*ck!]

Hello everyone: [F*ck!]

Lower Your Head: [F*ck!]

Clear: [F*ck!]

…

The entire screen was completely covered by a dense stream of curses.

After a while, other bullet comments appeared.

Death God: [It’s awesome to freeze a tsunami instantly!]

Little Painter: [Freeze!]

Water: [So cool.]

No Daughter in the Heart: [His words are the law!]

Thunderbolt from the Clear Sky: [This is even more enjoyable than watching a fantasy TV show.]

Newcomer: [How are bloggers still spreading slanderous words about him?]

Heaven and Earth: [God Lin, you still say that you’re not a god?]

…

Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Qin Yuxuan, Hu Tian, and the others all stared at the screen.

When Lin Fan froze the tsunami and killed the level-five Abyssal Octopus, their faces turned red.

Excited and happy!

…

Lin Fan looked at the ice in front of him, and his lips curled up.

This was the first time he had used the Advanced Ice Control Spell.

It was very mysterious.

He was very satisfied.

Then, Lin Fan turned his attention to the ancient chest beside him and opened it.

An emotionless voice immediately sounded in his ears.

[You’ve obtained Beginner Water Control Technique. Do you want to use it?]

At the same time, a crisp notification rang out in Lin Fan’s mind.

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve received a special red packed—Advanced Water Control Technique.]

Lin Fan’s body felt cool.

Then, in his vision, there were many water elements in the air.

As long as Lin Fan wanted to, he could gather all the water elements in an instant, forming a torrential rain or even a long river in the air.

Lin Fan had already experienced similar skills before, so he was able to digest this information.

Then, he turned to the Heavenly Hound and said, “Go and use this Beginner Water Control Technique.”

The Heavenly Hound was also shocked by the ice that had suddenly condensed in the air.

After a while, it reacted and touched the ball of light with its claws.

The ball of light entered its body.

The Heavenly Hound’s eyes flashed with a bright light, and its entire body became even more refreshed.

After everything was over, Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound did not stay any longer and continued walking forward.

Not long after Lin Fan left, the ice melted into water. Then, not a single drop was left behind as everything returned to the lake. It was extremely magical.

…

Taro Yamamoto was one of the chosen ones from Japes.

Taro Yamamoto had been extremely rebellious since he was young and liked to bully young children.

When he grew up, he drank all day long and became a street bully. Everyone stayed away from him.

After the doomsday declaration appeared, Taro Yamamoto became the chosen one and became the hero of Japes.

Most of the chosen ones who entered the Otherworld would try to get as much food, water, and weapons as possible.

Taro Yamamoto, on the other hand, stuffed a lot of wine into his backpack.

This caused Taro Yamamoto to often get drunk in the Otherworld.

Taro Yamamoto poured some wine into his mouth and cursed, “Why did I come to such a place?

“Hurry up and let me go back!”

At this moment, a pitch-black cave suddenly appeared in front of him.

Taro Yamamoto cursed, “Bah! Stop it!”

As he spoke, he raised his machine gun and fired at the cave.

Flames spewed out, and bullet shells flew everywhere!

Suddenly, a deafening roar sounded from the cave.

Taro Yamamoto did not show any fear.

He continued to shout, “Scaring me again!”

As soon as he finished speaking, he took out several grenades from his waist and threw them all inside.

There was a loud bang, and dust filled the sky.

The entire cave collapsed.

Then, Taro Yamamoto heard an emotionless voice.

[The first to kill a level-two Iron-Clawed Giant Rat. You’ve obtained a level-two treasure chest.]

[The first to kill a level-two Iron-Clawed Giant Rat. The area of Japes has increased by 10%.]

Then, an ancient chest appeared at the entrance of the collapsed cave.

Seeing this…

Taro Yamamoto’s eyes lit up. He instinctively felt that this was something good.

It might be an antique from the Otherworld!

It could be worth a lot of money!

Therefore, Taro Yamamoto quickened his pace and opened the chest impatiently.

[You’ve obtained a Body Petrification Spell. Do you want to use it?]

“What’s this?” Taro Yamamoto asked. “Use it!”

The light ball in the box directly entered his body.

Taro Yamamoto blinked his eyes.

In the next moment, his right hand turned into a stone, and he punched the tree in front of him.

The tree shook violently, and its bark shattered.

Taro Yamamoto looked at his right hand in disbelief and laughed maniacally.

Amidst the laughter, his right hand gradually returned to its original state.

…

The Japes’ live broadcast room was in an uproar.

Dong Yijun: [Taro Yamamoto casually threw a few grenades and killed a level-two beast!]

Moximoxi: [Moreover, he got a Body Petrification Spell from the treasure chest. He’s a real superman!]

Takeda: [Indeed, God’s will is on our side.]

Masaki-kun: [With this, Japes definitely doesn’t have to worry about the apocalypse anymore.]

Getting Water Up and Down: [Body petrification… Who can stop it? Not even beasts!]

Asai: [Area increased by 10%! The seawater around our island country has dropped! Moreover, many trees have grown.]

Xin: [That’s great! I want to build a house by the sea!]

Dream: [I want to build a house by the sea too.]

…

Lin Fan and the Heavenly Hound continued to roam the wilderness.

At this moment, a series of dull footsteps suddenly sounded in the distance.

In the next moment…

Taro Yamamoto, with his hair parted in the middle and a bottle of wine in his hand, suddenly appeared in front of him.

Taro Yamamoto took a sip of his wine. When he saw Lin Fan, his expression changed slightly.

It was a good thing for him to encounter humans from Earth in the Otherworld.

When he saw the Heavenly Hound beside Lin Fan, Taro Yamamoto’s eyes became even more heated.

In order to survive these days, Taro Yamamoto had already eaten up the few compressed biscuits he had. He could only eat some roots and weeds every day.

This wolf-like animal in front of him was simply the best meat!

After a while, he said to Lin Fan in the language of his country, “I’m Taro Yamamoto from Japes. Who are you?”

A look of disgust flashed across Lin Fan’s face as he said indifferently, “Hua Nation. Lin Fan.”
